description: Source code for CUDA NVTX (NVIDIA Tools Extension) bindings in PyTorch, providing functions for range marking and profiling, with platform-specific implementations for Windows and non-Windows systems.

classes.name: RangeHandle
classes.description: Structure representing a range handle for NVTX profiling, containing an ID and message.

methods.name: device_callback_range_end
methods.description: Callback to end a NVTX range and free associated resources.

methods.name: device_nvtxRangeEnd
methods.description: Ends a NVTX range on a specific CUDA stream.

methods.name: device_callback_range_start
methods.description: Starts a NVTX range and stores its ID.

methods.name: device_nvtxRangeStart
methods.description: Creates and starts a NVTX range on a CUDA stream.

methods.name: initNvtxBindings
methods.description: Initializes NVTX bindings in a Python module, exposing profiling functions.

methods.name: printUnavailableWarning
methods.description: Prints a warning that NVTX is unavailable on Windows.
